title.ru: Глагол to be: am, is, are
title.en: The verb to be: am, is, are
title.uz: To be fe'li: am, is, are

sum.ru: «Быть» в настоящем: кто ты, где ты, какой ты.
sum.en: “Be” in the present: who, where and what someone is.

ru: В русском «быть» в настоящем времени обычно пропускают («Я студент»), а в английском — никогда: I am a student.
Форма зависит от подлежащего: I → am, he / she / it → is, we / you / they → are.
Отрицание — not после глагола (I am not, she isn’t), вопрос — глагол в начале: Are you ready?
en: English never drops “be” in the present: I am a student, not “I student”.
The form depends on the subject: I → am, he / she / it → is, we / you / they → are.
For negatives put not after it (I am not, she isn’t); for questions move it to the front: Are you ready?
uz: O'zbek tilida «-man, -san» qo'shimchalari bor, ingliz tilida esa buning o'rniga to be ishlatiladi: I am a student — Men talabaman.
Shakl egaga bog'liq: I → am, he / she / it → is, we / you / they → are.
Inkor uchun fe'ldan keyin not qo'yiladi (I am not, she isn’t), so'roqda fe'l boshga chiqadi: Are you ready?

examples.s: I am a teacher.
She is at home now.
Are they your friends?

note.ru: В английском глагол нельзя пропускать, даже если по-русски его нет.
note.en: The verb can’t be left out, even when it feels obvious.
note.uz: Ingliz tilida fe'lni tushirib qoldirib bo'lmaydi.

tip.ru: I → am, he/she/it → is, we/you/they → are.
tip.en: I → am, he/she/it → is, we/you/they → are.
tip.uz: I → am, he/she/it → is, we/you/they → are.

e.en: she is one person, so is.
we means more than one → are.

e.ru: you всегда с are: Are you…?
e.en: you always takes are: Are you…?
e.uz: you doim are bilan: Are you…?

e.en: Without is the sentence is broken.

q.ru: Почему глагол меняется: am, is, are?
q.en: Why does the verb change: am, is, are?
q.uz: Nega fe'l o'zgaradi: am, is, are?

o.ru: Зависит от того, кто: I, he/she или we/they
o.en: It depends on who: I, he/she or we/they
o.uz: Kimligiga bog'liq: I, he/she yoki we/they

o.ru: Зависит от времени: сейчас или вчера
o.en: It depends on the time: now or yesterday

o.ru: Это просто разные слова, правила нет
o.en: They’re just different words, there’s no rule
o.uz: Bu shunchaki turli so'zlar, qoida yo'q

e.ru: Глагол нельзя пропускать: My name is…
e.en: The verb can’t be left out: My name is…
e.uz: Fe'lni tashlab bo'lmaydi: My name is…

e.ru: В вопросе глагол идёт первым; he → is.
e.en: In a question the verb comes first; he → is.
e.uz: So'roqda fe'l birinchi keladi; he → is.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения о себе и о друге с am, is или are.
write.en: Write 2 sentences about you and a friend using am, is or are.
write.uz: O'zingiz va do'stingiz haqida am, is yoki are bilan 2 ta gap yozing.

sum.ru: Что ты делаешь обычно, всегда, каждый день.
sum.en: What you usually, always or every day do.
sum.uz: Odatda, doim, har kuni nima qilasiz.

ru: Present Simple — для привычек, расписаний и фактов: I drink tea every morning.
С he / she / it к глаголу добавляется -s: she works, he goes, it watches.
Отрицание и вопрос — через do / does: I don’t like coffee. Does he play football? После does окончание -s уже не ставится.
en: Use Present Simple for habits, timetables and facts: I drink tea every morning.
With he / she / it the verb takes -s: she works, he goes, it watches.
Negatives and questions use do / does: I don’t like coffee. Does he play football? After does the verb loses its -s.
uz: Present Simple odatlar, jadval va faktlar uchun: I drink tea every morning — Har tongda choy ichaman.
He / she / it bilan fe'lga -s qo'shiladi: she works, he goes, it watches.
Inkor va so'roq do / does bilan yasaladi: I don’t like coffee. Does he play football? Does dan keyin fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi.

examples.s: He works in a bank.
We don’t watch TV in the morning.

t.ru: Мы не смотрим телевизор по утрам.

examples.s: Does your mum speak English?

note.ru: С he / she / it не забывай -s.
note.en: Don’t forget the -s with he / she / it.
note.uz: He / she / it bilan -s ni unutmang.

tip.ru: he/she/it + глагол-s; в вопросе и отрицании — does + глагол без -s.
tip.en: he/she/it + verb-s; in questions and negatives — does + verb without -s.
tip.uz: he/she/it + fe'l-s; so'roq va inkorda — does + -s siz fe'l.

e.en: they → don’t (doesn’t is only for he/she/it).

e.ru: -s уже есть в does, глагол остаётся like.
e.en: does already has the -s, so the verb stays like.
e.uz: -s does da bor, fe'l like bo'lib qoladi.

ex.q: She ___ (go) to the gym on Mondays.

q.ru: Что происходит с глаголом после she / he?
q.en: What happens to the verb after she / he?
q.uz: she / he dan keyin fe'l bilan nima bo'ladi?

o.ru: Добавляется -s, а в вопросе появляется does
o.en: It gets -s, and questions use does

e.ru: Привычка, каждый день → Present Simple, с I без -s.
e.en: A daily habit → Present Simple; no -s with I.
e.uz: Har kungi odat → Present Simple; I bilan -s yo'q.

e.en: After doesn’t the verb has no -s.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения: что ты делаешь каждый день и что делает кто-то из семьи.
write.en: Write 2 sentences: what you do every day and what someone in your family does.
write.uz: 2 ta gap yozing: har kuni nima qilasiz va oilangizdan kimdir nima qiladi.

sum.en: Any one thing, or that particular one.
sum.uz: Qandaydir narsa yoki aynan o'sha narsa.

ru: a / an — «один, какой-то», когда предмет упоминается впервые: I saw a cat. An — перед гласным звуком: an apple, an hour.
the — «тот самый», когда понятно, о чём речь, или предмет единственный: The cat was black. The sun is hot.
Перед множественным числом и неисчисляемыми в общем смысле артикль не нужен: I like dogs. Water is important.
en: a / an means “one, any” — use it when you mention something for the first time: I saw a cat. Use an before a vowel sound: an apple, an hour.
the means “that one” — when both people know which thing, or there is only one: The cat was black. The sun is hot.
No article with plurals or uncountable nouns in general: I like dogs. Water is important.
uz: a / an — «bitta, qandaydir», narsa birinchi marta tilga olinganda: I saw a cat. Unli tovushdan oldin an: an apple, an hour.
the — «aynan o'sha», qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotgani ma'lum bo'lsa yoki u yagona bo'lsa: The cat was black. The sun is hot.
Umumiy ma'noda ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar oldidan artikl qo'yilmaydi: I like dogs. Water is important.

formula: a + consonant sound: a book, a university
an + vowel sound: an egg, an hour
the + known / only one: the moon

examples.s: I bought a dress and a hat. The dress is red.

t.ru: Я купила платье и шляпу. Платье красное.
t.uz: Men ko'ylak va shlyapa sotib oldim. Ko'ylak qizil.

examples.s: She is an engineer.
Can you close the window, please?

note.ru: Важен звук, а не буква: h в honest не читается.
note.en: It’s the sound that matters: the h in honest is silent.
note.uz: Harf emas, tovush muhim: honest so'zida h o'qilmaydi.

tip.ru: Впервые и «какой-то» — a/an; понятно какой — the.
tip.en: First mention, “any one” — a/an; we know which — the.
tip.uz: Birinchi marta, «qandaydir» — a/an; qaysiligi ma'lum — the.

e.ru: umbrella начинается с гласного звука → an.
e.en: umbrella starts with a vowel sound → an.
There’s only one moon — the moon.

e.ru: Профессия: a + согласный звук → a pilot.
university читается «юни-», это согласный звук → a.
e.en: university starts with a “you” sound → a.

e.ru: h в hour не читается → an hour.
e.en: The h in hour is silent → an hour.
e.uz: hour da h o'qilmaydi → an hour.

s: I saw *a* dog in the park.

q.ru: Почему во втором предложении уже the?
q.en: Why does the second sentence use the?

o.en: The dog was already mentioned — we know which
o.uz: It allaqachon tilga olingan — qaysiligi ma'lum

o.ru: the всегда ставят в начале предложения

e.ru: idea начинается с гласного звука → an.
e.en: idea starts with a vowel sound → an.

checks.q: We bought a sofa. ___ sofa is grey.

e.en: The sofa was mentioned already — the.

write.ru: Опиши свою комнату в 2 предложениях с a/an и the.
write.en: Describe your room in 2 sentences using a/an and the.
write.uz: Xonangizni a/an va the bilan 2 ta gapda tasvirlang.

ru: Обычно добавляем -s: book → books, car → cars.
После -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o добавляем -es: bus → buses, box → boxes, tomato → tomatoes. Согласная + y → -ies: city → cities.
Есть исключения, их нужно запомнить: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice.
en: Usually add -s: book → books, car → cars.
After -s, -sh, -ch, -x and most -o add -es: bus → buses, box → boxes, tomato → tomatoes. Consonant + y → -ies: city → cities.
Some are irregular and just need learning: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice.
uz: Odatda -s qo'shiladi: book → books, car → cars.
-s, -sh, -ch, -x va ko'p -o dan keyin -es: bus → buses, box → boxes, tomato → tomatoes. Undosh + y → -ies: city → cities.
Istisnolarni yodlash kerak: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice.

examples.s: There are three buses at the stop.
The children are playing in the park.
Brush your teeth twice a day.

t.ru: Чисти зубы два раза в день.

note.en: child is irregular: the plural is children.

tip.ru: -s, после s/sh/ch/x/o — -es, согласная+y → -ies, а исключения запомни.
tip.en: -s; after s/sh/ch/x/o — -es; consonant+y → -ies; learn the irregulars.
tip.uz: -s; s/sh/ch/x/o dan keyin -es; undosh+y → -ies; istisnolarni yodlang.

ex.q: Two ___ are sitting on the bench.

o: My feet hurt after the walk.
My foots hurt after the walk.
I saw three mouses in the kitchen.
I saw three mice in the kitchen.

o.ru: Обычно -s, иногда -es, а некоторые слова особенные
o.en: Usually -s, sometimes -es, and some words are special

write.ru: Напиши, что лежит у тебя в сумке: 2 предложения с множественным числом.
write.en: Write what’s in your bag: 2 sentences with plural nouns.
write.uz: Sumkangizda nima borligini yozing: ko'plikdagi otlar bilan 2 ta gap.

sum.ru: Как сказать, что где-то что-то есть.
sum.en: How to say that something exists somewhere.

ru: There is / there are говорит, что что-то где-то есть: There is a park near my house.
There is — для одного предмета и неисчисляемого (There is some milk), there are — для нескольких (There are two chairs).
Отрицание: There isn’t / There aren’t any… Вопрос: Is there…? Are there…?
en: There is / there are says that something exists somewhere: There is a park near my house.
There is for one thing or uncountable nouns (There is some milk); there are for more than one (There are two chairs).
Negative: There isn’t / There aren’t any… Question: Is there…? Are there…?
uz: There is / there are biror joyda nimadir borligini bildiradi: There is a park near my house — Uyim yonida park bor.
Bitta narsa va sanalmaydigan otlar uchun there is (There is some milk), bir nechta narsa uchun there are (There are two chairs).
Inkor: There isn’t / There aren’t any… So'roq: Is there…? Are there…?

examples.s: There is a cat under the table.
There are many tourists in Samarkand.
Is there a bank near here?

mistake.wrong: In my room have a big window.
mistake.right: There is a big window in my room.

note.ru: «В комнате есть…» — это there is, а не have.
note.en: Use there is, not have, to say what a place contains.
note.uz: «Xonada … bor» — bu have emas, there is.

tip.ru: Одно — there is, много — there are.
tip.en: One — there is, many — there are.
tip.uz: Bitta — there is, ko'p — there are.

ex.q: There ___ a lot of books on the shelf.

e.ru: a lot of books — много, значит are.
e.en: a lot of books is plural → are.
e.uz: a lot of books — ko'plik → are.

ex.q: There ___ some water in the bottle.
___ there any eggs in the fridge?

o: There aren’t any shops in this street.
There isn’t any shops in this street.
In the city has a new museum.
There is a new museum in the city.

e.ru: «В городе есть…» = There is…, а не has.
e.en: “The city contains…” = There is…, not has.

ex.q: There ___ two cafés on this street.

s: *There is* a lamp on the desk.
*There are* two windows in my room.

q.en: When is it is, and when are?

o.ru: is — в вопросах, are — в утверждениях
o.en: is in questions, are in statements

checks.q: ___ a bus stop near my house.

e.ru: Что-то где-то есть, одно → There is.
e.en: Something exists somewhere, one → There is.
e.uz: Bir joyda bitta narsa bor → There is.

checks.q: There ___ three bedrooms in the flat.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения о своём городе с there is и there are.
write.en: Write 2 sentences about your town with there is and there are.
write.uz: Shahringiz haqida there is va there are bilan 2 ta gap yozing.

ru: Притяжательные местоимения стоят перед существительным: my, your, his, her, its, our, their — my phone, their house.
Принадлежность человеку — ’s: Anna’s car, my brother’s room. Если слово во множественном числе на -s, добавляем только апостроф: my parents’ flat.
Не путай its (его, её — о предмете) и it’s (= it is).
en: Possessive adjectives go before a noun: my, your, his, her, its, our, their — my phone, their house.
To show that something belongs to a person, add ’s: Anna’s car, my brother’s room. After a plural ending in -s, add only the apostrophe: my parents’ flat.
Don’t mix up its (belonging to it) and it’s (= it is).
uz: Egalik olmoshlari otdan oldin keladi: my, your, his, her, its, our, their — my phone, their house.
Biror narsa odamga tegishli bo'lsa, ’s qo'shiladi: Anna’s car — Annaning mashinasi. -s bilan tugaydigan ko'plikdan keyin faqat apostrof: my parents’ flat.
its (unga tegishli) va it’s (= it is) ni adashtirmang.

formula: I → my · you → your · he → his
she → her · it → its · we → our · they → their

examples.s: This is my sister’s bike.
They love their new flat.

t.ru: Им очень нравится их новая квартира.
t.uz: Ular yangi kvartiralarini juda yaxshi ko'rishadi.

examples.s: The dog is eating its food.

note.ru: it’s = it is; принадлежность — its без апострофа.
note.en: it’s = it is; the possessive is its with no apostrophe.
note.uz: it’s = it is; egalik — apostrofsiz its.

ex.q: Is this ___ pen? — Yes, it’s mine.

e.en: Before a noun it’s your (yours stands alone).

ex.q: Kate and Tom are washing ___ car.

e.ru: their — «их»; there и they’re — другие слова.
e.en: their means “belonging to them”; there and they’re are different words.
e.uz: their — «ularning»; there va they’re boshqa so'zlar.

e.ru: Перед name нужно her, а не she.
e.en: Before name you need her, not she.
e.uz: name oldidan she emas, her kerak.

e.ru: its = «его/её» о предмете; it’s = it is.
e.en: its = belonging to it; it’s = it is.
e.uz: its = unga tegishli; it’s = it is.

q.ru: Как в английском показать, чьё это?
q.en: How does English show whose something is?
q.uz: Ingliz tilida narsa kimga tegishli ekani qanday ko'rsatiladi?

checks.q: The phone fell and ___ screen broke.

e.en: Belonging to a thing — its, no apostrophe.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения о вещах своей семьи с my/his/her и ’s.
write.en: Write 2 sentences about your family’s things with my/his/her and ’s.
write.uz: Oilangiz buyumlari haqida my/his/her va ’s bilan 2 ta gap yozing.

sum.ru: Действие в процессе и планы на ближайшее время.
sum.en: Actions in progress and near-future plans.
sum.uz: Davom etayotgan ish va yaqin rejalar.

ru: am / is / are + глагол-ing — действие происходит сейчас: She is reading. They are waiting for the bus.
Так же говорят о временном (I’m living with my aunt this month) и о планах, о которых уже договорились: We’re meeting at six tomorrow.
Глаголы состояния (know, like, want, understand) обычно не ставят в -ing: I know, а не I’m knowing.
en: am / is / are + verb-ing shows an action happening now: She is reading. They are waiting for the bus.
It’s also used for temporary situations (I’m living with my aunt this month) and fixed plans: We’re meeting at six tomorrow.
State verbs (know, like, want, understand) usually don’t take -ing: I know, not I’m knowing.
uz: am / is / are + fe'l-ing — ish hozir sodir bo'lyapti: She is reading — U o'qiyapti.
Vaqtinchalik holatlar (I’m living with my aunt this month) va kelishilgan rejalar uchun ham: We’re meeting at six tomorrow.
Holat fe'llari (know, like, want, understand) odatda -ing olmaydi: I know, I’m knowing emas.

formula: I’m not · she isn’t · they aren’t + -ing

examples.s: Be quiet, the baby is sleeping.
What are you doing this weekend?

t.ru: Что ты делаешь в эти выходные?
t.uz: Shu dam olish kunlari nima qilyapsan?

examples.s: It isn’t raining any more.

note.ru: Без am / is / are форма -ing не работает.
note.en: The -ing form needs am / is / are before it.
note.uz: -ing shakli am / is / are siz ishlamaydi.

e.en: know is a state verb, no -ing.

e.ru: you → are: Why are you laughing?
e.en: you → are: Why are you laughing?
e.uz: you → are: Why are you laughing?

o: She is wanting a new phone.

e.en: want is a state: She wants.

o: We are having dinner at the moment.
We have dinner at the moment.

q.en: What do these actions have in common?

checks.q: Be quiet! I ___ a phone call.
We ___ to the cinema tonight. We have tickets.

e.en: love is a state verb — no -ing.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения: что ты и люди вокруг делаете прямо сейчас.
write.en: Write 2 sentences: what you and people around you are doing right now.
write.uz: 2 ta gap yozing: siz va atrofingizdagilar hozir nima qilyapsiz.

sum.ru: Законченные действия в прошлом, -ed и неправильные глаголы.
sum.en: Finished past actions, -ed and irregular verbs.
sum.uz: O'tmishda tugagan ishlar, -ed va noto'g'ri fe'llar.

ru: Past Simple — законченное действие в прошлом, часто со словами yesterday, last week, ago: I called her yesterday.
Правильные глаголы получают -ed (work → worked, live → lived, stop → stopped). Неправильные нужно запомнить: go → went, see → saw, buy → bought.
Отрицание и вопрос — через did, а глагол возвращается в начальную форму: I didn’t go. Did you see it?
en: Past Simple is for finished actions in the past, often with yesterday, last week, ago: I called her yesterday.
Regular verbs take -ed (work → worked, live → lived, stop → stopped). Irregular verbs must be learned: go → went, see → saw, buy → bought.
Negatives and questions use did, and the verb goes back to its base form: I didn’t go. Did you see it?
uz: Past Simple — o'tmishda tugagan ish, ko'pincha yesterday, last week, ago bilan: I called her yesterday — Kecha unga qo'ng'iroq qildim.
To'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi (work → worked, live → lived, stop → stopped). Noto'g'ri fe'llarni yodlash kerak: go → went, see → saw, buy → bought.
Inkor va so'roq did bilan, fe'l esa boshlang'ich shaklga qaytadi: I didn’t go. Did you see it?

examples.s: We visited Bukhara last summer.

t.ru: Прошлым летом мы были в Бухаре.

examples.s: She didn’t come to the party.
Did you buy bread?

note.ru: После did глагол в начальной форме: прошедшее время уже показал did.
note.en: After did use the base verb — did already shows the past.
note.uz: Did dan keyin fe'l boshlang'ich shaklda: o'tgan zamonni did ko'rsatadi.

tip.ru: + -ed / 2-я форма; вопрос и отрицание — did + начальная форма.
tip.en: + -ed / past form; questions and negatives — did + base verb.
tip.uz: + -ed / 2-shakl; so'roq va inkor — did + boshlang'ich shakl.

ex.q: I ___ a great film last night.

e.uz: last night → o'tgan zamon: see → saw.

ex.q: They ___ in London for two years. Now they live in Paris.

e.en: After didn’t use the base form: read.
e.uz: didn’t dan keyin boshlang'ich shakl: read.

e.ru: Вопрос в прошлом строится через did.
e.en: Past questions are built with did.

q.en: What do you notice about past verbs?

o.ru: Обычно -ed, но некоторые меняются целиком; в вопросе did
o.en: Usually -ed, some change completely; questions use did
o.uz: Odatda -ed, ba'zilari butunlay o'zgaradi; so'roqda did

checks.q: She ___ a new dress last week.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения о том, что ты делал вчера.
write.en: Write 2 sentences about what you did yesterday.
write.uz: Kecha nima qilganingiz haqida 2 ta gap yozing.

title.en: Prepositions of time: in, on, at

sum.ru: В понедельник, в 5 часов, в мае.
sum.en: On Monday, at five, in May.

ru: at — точное время и короткие моменты: at 7 o’clock, at noon, at night, at the weekend (брит.).
on — дни и даты: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday.
in — более длинные периоды: in May, in 2025, in summer, in the morning. Перед this / next / last / every предлог не нужен: next week.
en: at — exact times and short moments: at 7 o’clock, at noon, at night, at the weekend (UK).
on — days and dates: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday.
in — longer periods: in May, in 2025, in summer, in the morning. No preposition before this / next / last / every: next week.
uz: at — aniq vaqt va qisqa lahzalar: at 7 o’clock, at noon, at night.
on — kunlar va sanalar: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday.
in — uzunroq davrlar: in May, in 2025, in summer, in the morning. this / next / last / every oldidan predlog qo'yilmaydi: next week.

formula: in + month / year / season: in July

examples.s: The lesson starts at nine.
I was born in 2008.
See you on Sunday!

note.en: Days of the week take on.

tip.ru: Часы — at, дни — on, месяцы/годы/сезоны — in.
tip.en: Clock times — at, days — on, months/years/seasons — in.
tip.uz: Soat — at, kun — on, oy/yil/fasl — in.

o: I don’t like working at night.
I don’t like working in night.
We’re going to Turkey on next month.
We’re going to Turkey next month.

q.ru: От чего зависит выбор at / on / in?
q.uz: at / on / in tanlovi nimaga bog'liq?

o.ru: От размера отрезка: время → день → месяц/сезон
o.en: How big the time is: clock time → day → month/season
On the verb in the sentence

write.ru: Напиши о своей неделе 2 предложения с at, on и in.
write.en: Write 2 sentences about your week with at, on and in.
write.uz: Haftangiz haqida at, on va in bilan 2 ta gap yozing.

ru: Короткие прилагательные: -er и the -est — cheap → cheaper → the cheapest; big → bigger → the biggest; happy → happier → the happiest.
Длинные прилагательные: more и the most — expensive → more expensive → the most expensive.
Исключения: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst, far → further → the furthest. После сравнительной степени — than: Tea is cheaper than coffee.
en: Short adjectives take -er and the -est: cheap → cheaper → the cheapest; big → bigger → the biggest; happy → happier → the happiest.
Long adjectives use more and the most: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive.
Irregular: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst, far → further → the furthest. Use than after a comparative: Tea is cheaper than coffee.
uz: Qisqa sifatlar -er va the -est oladi: cheap → cheaper → the cheapest; big → bigger → the biggest; happy → happier → the happiest.
Uzun sifatlar more va the most bilan: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive.
Istisnolar: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst. Qiyoslashdan keyin than: Tea is cheaper than coffee — Choy qahvadan arzonroq.

formula: good → better → best · bad → worse → worst

examples.s: My bag is heavier than yours.
This is the most beautiful place in the city.

t.ru: Это самое красивое место в городе.

examples.s: Today is better than yesterday.

mistake.wrong: She is more tall than her brother.
mistake.right: She is taller than her brother.

tip.ru: Короткие — -er/-est, длинные — more/most, после сравнения — than.

ex.q: A plane is ___ than a train.
It was ___ day of my life.
This exercise is ___ than the last one.

s: A car is *faster* than a bike.

o.en: Short words take -er, long ones take more

e.ru: the + самый → most для длинного слова.
e.en: the + “-est” idea → most for long words.

write.ru: Сравни два города или двух людей в 2 предложениях.
write.en: Compare two cities or two people in 2 sentences.
write.uz: Ikki shahar yoki ikki odamni 2 ta gapda qiyoslang.

title.en: The future: will and going to
title.uz: Kelasi zamon: will va going to

sum.ru: Решение в моменте или план заранее.
sum.en: A decision now, or a plan made before.
sum.uz: Shu zahotiyoq qaror yoki oldindan reja.

ru: will + глагол — решение, принятое прямо сейчас, обещание или предположение: I’ll help you. I think it will rain.
be going to + глагол — план, о котором решили заранее, или то, что вот-вот случится по видимым признакам: I’m going to study medicine. Look at the clouds — it’s going to rain.
Отрицание: won’t (= will not) и am / is / are not going to.
en: will + verb — a decision made now, a promise or a prediction: I’ll help you. I think it will rain.
be going to + verb — a plan decided earlier, or something we can see coming: I’m going to study medicine. Look at the clouds — it’s going to rain.
Negatives: won’t (= will not) and am / is / are not going to.
uz: will + fe'l — shu zahoti qilingan qaror, va'da yoki taxmin: I’ll help you — Senga yordam beraman.
be going to + fe'l — oldindan qilingan reja yoki belgilarga qarab bo'lishi aniq ish: I’m going to study medicine. Look at the clouds — it’s going to rain.
Inkor: won’t (= will not) va am / is / are not going to.

formula: am / is / are going to + verb
decision now → will · plan → going to

examples.s: The phone is ringing. — I’ll answer it.
We’re going to move to a new flat in March.

t.ru: В марте мы переезжаем в новую квартиру.

examples.s: Don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone.

t.ru: Не волнуйся, я никому не скажу.

mistake.wrong: I will to call you later.

note.en: After will use the verb without to.
note.uz: Will dan keyin fe'l to siz keladi.

tip.ru: Решил сейчас — will; решил заранее — going to.
tip.en: Decided now — will; decided before — going to.
tip.uz: Hozir qaror qildi — will; oldindan — going to.

ex.q: I’m thirsty. — Wait, I ___ get you some water.
She has bought paint. She ___ paint her room.

e.ru: Краска уже куплена — план → is going to.
e.en: The paint is bought — a plan → is going to.
e.uz: Bo'yoq olingan — reja → is going to.

ex.q: I promise I ___ be late again.

o: Look out! You’re going to fall!
Look out! You will to fall!

e.ru: Видно, что сейчас случится → going to; will to не бывает.
e.en: We can see it coming → going to; “will to” doesn’t exist.
e.uz: Bo'lishi ko'rinib turibdi → going to; «will to» bo'lmaydi.

o: They are going to visit us.

e.en: going to + verb: to is required.

ex.q: It’s cold. I ___ close the window. (decision now, short form)

s: It’s dark. I*’ll turn* on the light.
I*’m going to* study abroad next year.
Look! That glass *is going to* fall!

q.ru: Чем отличается первый пример от второго?
q.en: How is the first example different from the second?
q.uz: Birinchi misol ikkinchisidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?

o.ru: Первое — решение в моменте, второе — заранее спланировано
o.en: The first is decided now, the second was planned
o.uz: Birinchisi hozir qaror qilingan, ikkinchisi oldindan rejalashtirilgan

o.en: The first is in the past

checks.q: The bag looks heavy. I ___ help you.
I ___ start a new job on Monday. It’s all arranged.

e.en: A plan made before → going to.
The negative of will is won’t.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения: один план (going to) и одно предсказание (will).
write.en: Write 2 sentences: one plan (going to) and one prediction (will).
write.uz: 2 ta gap yozing: bitta reja (going to) va bitta bashorat (will).

title.ru: Исчисляемые и неисчисляемые: much, many, some, any
title.en: Countable and uncountable: much, many, some, any
title.uz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar: much, many, some, any

ru: Исчисляемые можно посчитать (an apple, two apples), неисчисляемые — нет: water, money, advice, information, bread.
many — с исчисляемыми (many friends), much — с неисчисляемыми (much time), чаще в вопросах и отрицаниях. a lot of подходит к обоим.
some — в утверждениях и вежливых просьбах (some milk, Would you like some tea?), any — в вопросах и отрицаниях (Do you have any questions? I don’t have any money).
en: Countable nouns can be counted (an apple, two apples); uncountable nouns can’t: water, money, advice, information, bread.
many goes with countable nouns (many friends), much with uncountable ones (much time), mostly in questions and negatives. a lot of works with both.
some in positive sentences and offers (some milk, Would you like some tea?), any in questions and negatives (Do you have any questions? I don’t have any money).
uz: Sanaladigan otlarni sanash mumkin (an apple, two apples), sanalmaydiganlarni — yo'q: water, money, advice, information, bread.
many sanaladigan bilan (many friends), much sanalmaydigan bilan (much time), ko'proq so'roq va inkorda. a lot of ikkalasiga ham mos.
some tasdiq va taklifda (some milk, Would you like some tea?), any so'roq va inkorda (Do you have any questions?).

examples.s: How much money do you need?
There aren’t many people here today.

t.uz: Bugun bu yerda odam ko'p emas.

examples.s: Can I give you some advice?

mistake.wrong: Can you give me some informations?
mistake.right: Can you give me some information?

note.ru: information неисчисляемое — без -s и без an.
note.en: information is uncountable — no -s, no an.

tip.ru: Можно посчитать — many, нельзя — much; some в утверждении, any в вопросе и отрицании.
tip.en: Can count — many, can’t — much; some in positives, any in questions and negatives.
tip.uz: Sanash mumkin — many, mumkin emas — much; tasdiqda some, so'roq va inkorda any.

ex.q: Is there ___ sugar in my tea?

o: She gave me a good advice.
She gave me some good advice.

e.ru: advice неисчисляемое: some advice, не an advice.
e.en: advice is uncountable: some advice, not an advice.
e.uz: advice sanalmaydi: some advice, an advice emas.

o: I bought some apples at the market.
I bought any apples at the market.

q.ru: Почему apples — many, а sugar — much?
q.en: Why many apples but much sugar?
q.uz: Nega many apples, lekin much sugar?

o.en: You can count apples, not sugar

o.ru: much — для еды, many — для фруктов
o.en: much for food, many for fruit

write.ru: Напиши, что есть и чего нет у тебя на кухне: 2 предложения с some/any/much/many.
write.en: Write what you have and don’t have in your kitchen: 2 sentences with some/any/much/many.
write.uz: Oshxonangizda nima bor va nima yo'qligini some/any/much/many bilan 2 ta gapda yozing.

sum.ru: Have you ever…? I’ve just finished.
sum.en: Have you ever…? I’ve just finished.
sum.uz: Have you ever…? I’ve just finished.

ru: have / has + третья форма глагола (V3): I have finished, she has seen.

Используем, когда важен результат сейчас (I’ve lost my keys — ключей нет), жизненный опыт без точного времени (Have you ever been to Japan?) и действие, которое длится до сих пор (We’ve lived here for five years).
Часто со словами ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since.
en: have / has + past participle (V3): I have finished, she has seen.

Use it when the result matters now (I’ve lost my keys — I don’t have them), for life experience with no exact time (Have you ever been to Japan?) and for something that continues until now (We’ve lived here for five years).
Common words: ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since.
uz: have / has + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3): I have finished, she has seen.
Natija hozir muhim bo'lsa (I’ve lost my keys — kalitlar yo'q), aniq vaqtsiz hayotiy tajriba (Have you ever been to Japan?) va hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat uchun (We’ve lived here for five years).
Ko'pincha ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since bilan.

examples.s: I’ve never tried sushi.

t.uz: Men hech qachon sushi tatib ko'rmaganman.

examples.s: She has just left.
Have you finished your homework yet?

note.ru: Действие длится с прошлого до сих пор — Present Perfect, а не Present Simple.
note.en: Something going on from the past until now needs Present Perfect.
note.uz: O'tmishdan hozirgacha davom etsa — Present Perfect kerak.

tip.ru: have/has + V3; for — сколько, since — с какого момента.
tip.en: have/has + V3; for — how long, since — from when.
tip.uz: have/has + V3; for — qancha vaqt, since — qachondan beri.

ex.q: He has worked here ___ ten years.

e.en: ten years is a length of time → for.

o: We have known each other since school.
We know each other since school.

e.ru: since + до сих пор → have known.

ex.q: They have lived in this house ___ 2015.

s: I*’ve lost* my keys. I can’t open the door.
We*’ve lived* here for ten years.

o.ru: Прошлое связано с «сейчас»: результат, опыт, длится до сих пор
o.en: The past is linked to now: a result, experience, or still going on
o.uz: O'tmish hozir bilan bog'liq: natija, tajriba yoki hali davom etmoqda

checks.q: She ___ her homework, so she can go out.

e.en: A result now; she → has + V3.

write.ru: Напиши 2 предложения о своём опыте: что ты уже делал, а что никогда.
write.en: Write 2 sentences about your experience: something you’ve done and something you’ve never done.
write.uz: Tajribangiz haqida 2 ta gap yozing: nima qilgansiz va nimani hech qachon qilmagansiz.

sum.ru: Когда важно время, а когда — результат.
sum.en: When the time matters, and when the result does.

ru: Есть точное прошедшее время (yesterday, in 2019, last week, two days ago, when…) — только Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.
Время не важно или не названо, важен опыт или результат сейчас — Present Perfect: I’ve seen this film.
Обычно разговор начинается с Present Perfect, а подробности идут в Past Simple: I’ve been to Paris. I went there in 2022.
en: If a finished time is mentioned (yesterday, in 2019, last week, two days ago, when…), use Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.
If the time isn’t important or isn’t said and the experience or result matters now, use Present Perfect: I’ve seen this film.
Conversations often start with Present Perfect and move to Past Simple for details: I’ve been to Paris. I went there in 2022.
uz: Aniq o'tgan vaqt aytilsa (yesterday, in 2019, last week, two days ago, when…) — faqat Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.
Vaqt muhim emas yoki aytilmagan, tajriba yoki natija hozir muhim bo'lsa — Present Perfect: I’ve seen this film.
Suhbat ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan boshlanadi, tafsilotlar Past Simple da: I’ve been to Paris. I went there in 2022.

formula: ever / never / just / yet → Present Perfect
I’ve been… → I went there in…

examples.s: I’ve lost my wallet. I lost it on the bus.

t.ru: Я потерял кошелёк. Я потерял его в автобусе.
t.uz: Hamyonimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Uni avtobusda yo'qotdim.

examples.s: Did you watch the match last night?
She has visited many countries.

mistake.wrong: I have met her two years ago.
mistake.right: I met her two years ago.

note.ru: ago — точное время в прошлом, значит Past Simple.
note.en: ago marks a finished time, so use Past Simple.
note.uz: ago — aniq o'tgan vaqt, demak Past Simple.

tip.ru: Назван момент в прошлом — Past Simple; нет момента, важен результат — Present Perfect.
tip.en: A past time is named — Past Simple; no time, result matters — Present Perfect.
tip.uz: O'tgan vaqt aytilgan — Past Simple; vaqt yo'q, natija muhim — Present Perfect.

ex.q: I ___ him at the cinema last Friday.
___ you ever eaten plov in Samarkand?

e.ru: Опыт без времени → Have you ever eaten.
e.en: Experience, no time → Have you ever eaten.
e.uz: Vaqtsiz tajriba → Have you ever eaten.

e.ru: When спрашивает о моменте → did you arrive.
e.en: When asks for a moment → did you arrive.
e.uz: When lahzani so'raydi → did you arrive.

o: I’ve just seen a great film.
I’ve seen a great film yesterday.

e.ru: just и без времени → Present Perfect; yesterday требует Past Simple.
e.en: just, no time → Present Perfect; yesterday needs Past Simple.
e.uz: just, vaqtsiz → Present Perfect; yesterday Past Simple talab qiladi.

s: She *has broken* her arm. She *broke* it *yesterday*.

q.en: When do we choose Past Simple?

o.en: When we say when it happened

e.ru: last Saturday — точное время → Past Simple.
e.en: last Saturday is a finished time → Past Simple.
e.uz: last Saturday — aniq vaqt → Past Simple.

checks.q: I ___ this book. Do you want it?

e.ru: Времени нет, важен результат → Present Perfect.
e.en: No time given, the result matters → Present Perfect.
e.uz: Vaqt yo'q, natija muhim → Present Perfect.

checks.q: I’ve been to Tokyo. I ___ there in 2023.

e.en: A detail with a date → Past Simple.

write.ru: Напиши об одном месте: была ли ты/был ли ты там (Present Perfect) и когда (Past Simple).
write.en: Write about a place: have you been there (Present Perfect) and when (Past Simple)?
write.uz: Bir joy haqida yozing: u yerda bo'lganmisiz (Present Perfect) va qachon (Past Simple).

sum.en: A real “if” and an imagined one.

ru: Первый тип — реальная возможность в будущем: if + Present Simple, will + глагол. If it rains, we’ll stay at home. После if will не ставим.
Второй тип — нереальная или маловероятная ситуация сейчас: if + Past Simple, would + глагол. If I had more time, I would learn Japanese.
Во втором типе часто говорят were для всех лиц: If I were you, I’d accept the offer.
en: First conditional — a real possibility in the future: if + Present Simple, will + verb. If it rains, we’ll stay at home. Don’t use will after if.
Second conditional — an unreal or unlikely situation now: if + Past Simple, would + verb. If I had more time, I would learn Japanese.
In the second conditional we often use were for everyone: If I were you, I’d accept the offer.
uz: 1-tur — kelajakdagi haqiqiy imkoniyat: if + Present Simple, will + fe'l. If it rains, we’ll stay at home. If dan keyin will qo'yilmaydi.
2-tur — hozirgi xayoliy yoki ehtimoli kam holat: if + Past Simple, would + fe'l. If I had more time, I would learn Japanese.
2-turda ko'pincha barcha shaxslar uchun were: If I were you, I’d accept the offer.

examples.s: If you study hard, you’ll pass the exam.

t.ru: Если будешь усердно заниматься, сдашь экзамен.

examples.s: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.

t.ru: Если бы я выиграл в лотерею, я бы объехал весь мир.
t.uz: Lotereyada yutsam edi, butun dunyoni aylanardim.

examples.s: What would you do if you were a teacher?

t.ru: Что бы ты делал, если бы был учителем?

mistake.wrong: If it will be sunny, we’ll go to the beach.
mistake.right: If it is sunny, we’ll go to the beach.

note.ru: После if — настоящее время, даже когда речь о будущем.
note.en: After if use the present, even about the future.
note.uz: If dan keyin, kelajak haqida bo'lsa ham, hozirgi zamon.

tip.ru: Реально: if + present → will. Воображаемо: if + past → would.
tip.en: Real: if + present → will. Imagined: if + past → would.
tip.uz: Haqiqiy: if + present → will. Xayoliy: if + past → would.

ex.q: If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
If she calls, I ___ tell her the news.

o: If I will see him, I’ll tell him.
If I see him, I’ll tell him.
If I had a car, I would drive to work.
If I have a car, I would drive to work.

ex.q: If I ___ (be) you, I would apologise.

e.ru: If I were you — устойчивый совет.
e.en: If I were you is the fixed form for advice.
e.uz: If I were you — maslahatning turg'un shakli.

s: If I *were* you, I*’d* call her.

q.ru: Чем второй пример отличается от первого?
q.en: How is the second example different from the first?
q.uz: Ikkinchi misol birinchisidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?

o.en: The first is real, the second is imaginary
The second is about the past

checks.q: If you ___ now, you’ll catch the train.
If I knew her number, I ___ call her.
If I ___ you, I’d take the job.

write.ru: Закончи 2 фразы: «If I have time tomorrow, …» и «If I lived in another country, …».
write.en: Finish 2 sentences: “If I have time tomorrow, …” and “If I lived in another country, …”.
write.uz: 2 ta gapni tugating: «If I have time tomorrow, …» va «If I lived in another country, …».

title.ru: Модальные: must, have to, should, can
title.en: Modal verbs: must, have to, should, can
title.uz: Modal fe'llar: must, have to, should, can

sum.en: Need to, have to, ought to, may.

ru: После модальных глагол без to и без -s: She can swim (не cans, не can to swim).
must — сильная необходимость, часто по мнению говорящего; have to — обязанность из-за правил или обстоятельств: I have to wear a uniform. Должен в прошлом — had to.
should — совет (You should see a doctor), can — умение и разрешение. Важно: mustn’t = нельзя, а don’t have to = не обязательно.
en: After a modal verb use the base verb, with no to and no -s: She can swim (not cans, not can to swim).
must — strong necessity, often the speaker’s opinion; have to — an obligation from rules or circumstances: I have to wear a uniform. In the past use had to.
should — advice (You should see a doctor); can — ability and permission. Careful: mustn’t = it’s forbidden, don’t have to = it’s not necessary.
uz: Modal fe'ldan keyin fe'l to siz va -s siz: She can swim (cans ham, can to swim ham emas).
must — kuchli zarurat, ko'pincha so'zlovchining fikri; have to — qoida yoki sharoit tufayli majburiyat: I have to wear a uniform. O'tgan zamonda — had to.
should — maslahat (You should see a doctor), can — qobiliyat va ruxsat. Diqqat: mustn’t = mumkin emas, don’t have to = shart emas.

examples.s: You mustn’t use your phone during the exam.

t.ru: Во время экзамена нельзя пользоваться телефоном.
t.uz: Imtihon paytida telefondan foydalanish mumkin emas.

examples.s: You don’t have to come if you’re busy.
I think you should rest a little.

note.ru: После must, can, should — без to.
note.en: No to after must, can or should.
note.uz: must, can, should dan keyin to qo'yilmaydi.

tip.ru: Модальный + глагол без to; mustn’t — нельзя, don’t have to — не обязательно.
tip.en: Modal + verb without to; mustn’t — forbidden, don’t have to — not necessary.
tip.uz: Modal + to siz fe'l; mustn’t — mumkin emas, don’t have to — shart emas.

ex.q: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early.
It’s Sunday, so I ___ get up early.
Yesterday I ___ stay at work until nine.

e.en: Obligation in the past → had to.

s: You *don’t have to* pay — it’s free.

q.ru: Чем mustn’t отличается от don’t have to?
q.en: How is mustn’t different from don’t have to?
q.uz: mustn’t va don’t have to qanday farq qiladi?

o.ru: mustn’t — нельзя, don’t have to — не обязательно
o.en: mustn’t = forbidden, don’t have to = not necessary
o.uz: mustn’t — mumkin emas, don’t have to — shart emas

e.ru: После can — глагол без to и без -s.
e.en: After can — the verb without to or -s.
e.uz: can dan keyin — to va -s siz fe'l.

checks.q: At my school we ___ wear a uniform. It’s a rule.

write.ru: Напиши 2 правила своей школы или дома с must/mustn’t/have to.
write.en: Write 2 rules of your school or home with must/mustn’t/have to.
write.uz: Maktab yoki uy qoidalaridan 2 tasini must/mustn’t/have to bilan yozing.

sum.ru: Не кто сделал, а что было сделано.
sum.en: Not who did it, but what was done.

ru: Пассив — когда важно действие, а не тот, кто его совершил: The bridge was built in 1990.
Строится: be в нужном времени + третья форма глагола (V3): is made, was written, has been sold, will be opened.
Если нужно сказать, кем сделано, используем by: The book was written by Abdulla Qodiriy.
en: Use the passive when the action matters more than who did it: The bridge was built in 1990.
Form: be in the right tense + past participle (V3): is made, was written, has been sold, will be opened.
To say who did it, add by: The book was written by Abdulla Qodiriy.
uz: Majhul nisbat — ishni kim qilgani emas, ishning o'zi muhim bo'lganda: The bridge was built in 1990 — Ko'prik 1990-yilda qurilgan.
Yasalishi: kerakli zamondagi be + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3): is made, was written, has been sold, will be opened.
Kim tomonidan qilinganini aytish uchun by: The book was written by Abdulla Qodiriy.

formula: is made · was made · will be made

examples.s: English is spoken all over the world.

t.ru: На английском говорят во всём мире.

examples.s: My phone was stolen yesterday.
The results will be announced on Monday.

mistake.wrong: The letter was wrote by my grandfather.
mistake.right: The letter was written by my grandfather.

note.ru: В пассиве нужна третья форма (V3), а не вторая.
note.en: The passive needs the past participle (V3), not the past form.

tip.ru: be (в нужном времени) + V3; кем — by.
tip.en: be (right tense) + V3; who did it — by.
tip.uz: be (kerakli zamonda) + V3; kim tomonidan — by.

e.ru: Сыр не делает сам → is made.
e.en: Cheese doesn’t make anything → is made.

ex.q: The window ___ by the wind last night.

e.ru: Окно разбил ветер, last night → was broken.
e.en: The wind broke it, last night → was broken.
e.uz: Shamol sindirdi, last night → was broken.

e.en: Someone will build it → will be built.

o: The film was directed by a young woman.
The film was direct by a young woman.
Rice is grow in many countries.
Rice is grown in many countries.

ex.q: The Registan ___ (visit) by thousands of tourists every year.

q.en: What changes in the second sentence?

o.ru: Важен дом, а не тот, кто строил: be + V3
o.en: The house matters, not the builder: be + V3
o.uz: Kim qurgani emas, uy muhim: be + V3

e.ru: Телефоны не делают сами → are + made.
e.en: Phones don’t make anything → are + made.

checks.q: The picture was painted ___ my grandmother.

write.ru: Напиши 2 факта о своей стране в пассиве (например, «… is grown / was built …»).
write.en: Write 2 facts about your country in the passive (e.g. “… is grown / was built …”).
write.uz: Mamlakatingiz haqida majhul nisbatda 2 ta fakt yozing (masalan, «… is grown / was built …»).

sum.en: The person who…, the book which…

ru: who — о людях: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
which — о предметах и животных: The phone which I bought is great. that можно использовать и для людей, и для предметов.
Если who / which / that — дополнение (после него идёт подлежащее), его можно опустить: The film (that) we watched was boring.
en: who is for people: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
which is for things and animals: The phone which I bought is great. that can be used for both people and things.
When who / which / that is the object (a subject follows it), you can leave it out: The film (that) we watched was boring.
uz: who — odamlar uchun: The woman who lives next door is a doctor — Qo'shnimiz bo'lgan ayol shifokor.
which — narsalar va hayvonlar uchun: The phone which I bought is great. that ham odam, ham narsa uchun ishlatiladi.
Agar who / which / that to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa (undan keyin ega kelsa), uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin: The film (that) we watched was boring.

examples.s: I have a friend who speaks five languages.

t.ru: У меня есть друг, который говорит на пяти языках.

examples.s: This is the bag which I lost last week.

t.ru: Это сумка, которую я потерял на прошлой неделе.

examples.s: The café we went to was very cosy.

t.ru: Кафе, в которое мы ходили, было очень уютным.
t.uz: Biz borgan kafe juda shinam edi.

mistake.wrong: The man which helped me was very kind.
mistake.right: The man who helped me was very kind.

note.ru: О человеке — who (или that), не which.
note.en: For people use who (or that), not which.
note.uz: Odam haqida — which emas, who (yoki that).

tip.ru: Люди — who, предметы — which, оба — that.
tip.en: People — who, things — which, both — that.
tip.uz: Odamlar — who, narsalar — which, ikkalasi — that.

ex.q: The girl ___ won the race is my cousin.
I can’t find the book ___ you gave me.
A dentist is a person ___ looks after your teeth.

o: This is the song which I told you about.
This is the song who I told you about.

e.en: song is a thing → which, not who.

o: The teacher which taught us maths has retired.
The teacher who taught us maths has retired.

ex.q: That’s the car ___ my dad wants to buy. (thing)

e.en: car is a thing → which (or that).

s: The man *who* lives upstairs is a pilot.
I lost the key *which* opens the garage.
The film *(that)* we saw was great.

q.en: When is it who and when which?

o.ru: who — о людях, which — о предметах
o.en: who for people, which for things

checks.q: I know a girl ___ plays the violin.
This is the bike ___ I bought.
The cake ___ she made was great.

e.ru: После cake идёт she — слово можно опустить.
e.en: she follows, so the word can be left out.
e.uz: Keyin she keladi — so'zni tushirish mumkin.

write.ru: Опиши друга и любимую вещь двумя предложениями с who и which.
write.en: Describe a friend and a favourite thing in 2 sentences with who and which.
write.uz: Do'stingiz va sevimli narsangizni who va which bilan 2 ta gapda tasvirlang.

reading.title: My new flat
reading.text: Hi! My name is Lola. I am nineteen and I am a student. I live in a small flat near the university. There is a kitchen, a bathroom and one bedroom. My flat isn’t big, but it’s very bright. Every morning I drink tea and walk to my classes. My best friend, Dilnoza, lives next door. Her flat has two bedrooms and a balcony. On Sundays we cook plov together.

qs.q: How many bedrooms are there in Lola’s flat?
What do the friends do on Sundays?

write.ru: Напиши 3 предложения о себе: кто ты, где живёшь и что делаешь каждый день.
write.en: Write 3 sentences about yourself: who you are, where you live and what you do every day.
write.uz: O'zingiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing: kimsiz, qayerda yashaysiz va har kuni nima qilasiz.

reading.title: A weekend trip
reading.text: Last weekend Timur and his sister went to Samarkand by train. The trip was faster than they expected — only two hours. On Saturday they visited the Registan. It was crowded, but it was the most beautiful place they had ever seen. They didn’t have much money, so they ate in a cheap café. On Sunday it rained, and they stayed in the hotel. Next month they are going to visit Bukhara.

qs.q: How did they travel to Samarkand?
What did they do on Sunday?
What is their plan for next month?

write.ru: Напиши 3 предложения о своих последних выходных и о плане на следующие.
write.en: Write 3 sentences about your last weekend and your plan for the next one.
write.uz: O'tgan dam olish kunlaringiz va keyingisi uchun rejangiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing.

reading.title: The library café
reading.text: The old city library, which was built in 1912, has recently opened a café on its ground floor. Since it opened, the number of visitors has doubled. Students who used to study at home now come every afternoon. The manager says that if the café keeps being this popular, they will open the library on Sundays too. However, some readers think a library should be quiet, and they have complained about the noise. Visitors mustn’t bring their own food, but they don’t have to buy anything to sit there.

qs.q: What has happened since the café opened?
o: There are twice as many visitors.
They can bring their own food.
They don’t have to buy anything.

write.ru: Напиши 3 предложения: что ты уже сделал в этом году, что было в прошлом году и что сделал бы, если бы было больше времени.
write.en: Write 3 sentences: something you’ve done this year, something from last year, and what you would do if you had more time.
write.uz: 3 ta gap yozing: bu yil nima qildingiz, o'tgan yil nima bo'ldi va ko'proq vaqtingiz bo'lsa nima qilardingiz.
